Subject: ClearPath pilot: summary, decision owners, and timeline

Hi Emma / Liam —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Below is a concise recap so we’re aligned on what success looks like and the proposed mutual action plan. I pulled the key items from our conversation and included an initial timeline (attached: redwood-map-v1.pdf).

Quick recap of pain & goal:
- Pain: Latency and cost spikes in real-time inference for conversational support, especially during high-concurrency peaks. Current infra can’t sustain sub-200ms per-response SLA at scale.
- Goal: Pilot that demonstrates 50% lower per-token cost and consistent 150–200ms tail latency for your 99th percentile conversational queries with privacy controls.

Mutual Action Plan (draft) — owners and target dates:
1) Pilot scope & acceptance criteria — owner: Emma Sullivan (ClearPath) / Marcus Lin (Redwood) — target: 2026-09-14
2) Environment & data access (sample dataset, VPC requirements) — owner: Liam O'Connor (ClearPath) / Aditya Rao (Redwood infra lead) — target: 2026-09-20
3) Trial deployment (hosted/dedicated decision) & initial performance run — owner: Redwood infra / ClearPath eng — target: 2026-09-28
4) Performance review & go/no-go decision — owner: Emma + ClearPath execs / Marcus — target: 2026-10-05
5) Procurement & legal sign-off (SOW/PO) — owner: ClearPath procurement / Redwood sales — target: 2026-10-12

Decision-makers you mentioned on the call:
- Emma Sullivan (Product lead) — primary champion
- Rajesh Patel (VP Eng) — technical sign-off (not on this thread yet)
- Procurement (procurement@clearpath.ai) — commercial/PO

Open items for Redwood to provide before next sync:
- Narrowed pricing estimate for a 60-day pilot (hosted vs dedicated options) — will send tomorrow.
- Short SOC2 summary and data handling doc — attaching a one-page summary.
- Proposed runbook for onboarding sample data and test harness.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll share pricing + SOC2 summary tomorrow.
- Aditya will follow up on the VPC/access checklist by Tuesday.
- Let’s schedule a 45-min pilot kickoff for the week of 9/20 — please share availability.

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft)

Thanks — talk soon.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0142

Emma — thanks, appreciate the quick follow. Short answers inline and next steps below.

Data residency: yes — hosted pilot nodes can be pinned to US regions only. If you prefer VPC/dedicated for absolute isolation, that’s also an option; I’ve included both price lines in the attached quote (redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx).
Estimated engineering effort:
- Integration (sample dataset ingestion + test harness): ~16–32 engineering hours (one SWE + one infra engineer to validate).
- Validation/perf tuning run: ~8–16 ops hours.

Pricing snapshot (high level, see attachment for line items):
- Hosted pilot (US-only): $12,000 flat for 60 days (includes 2M tokens + infra credits), plus overage at $X/1k tokens.
- Dedicated pilot (reserved slot): $28,000 for 60 days (includes reserved capacity for peak windows) — recommended if you expect steady high concurrency during pilot.

Updated MAP items (I added Rajesh and procurement ownership):
- 9/14 — confirm acceptance criteria (Emma + Rajesh)
- 9/17 — access & sample data delivered (ClearPath eng)
- 9/21 — deployment & baseline run (Redwood infra + ClearPath eng)
- 10/05 — performance review / go-no-go (executive stakeholders)
- 10/12 — procurement complete / SOW signed

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx (pricing + T&Cs)

Proposed next call: Wed 2026-09-15, 10:00–10:45am PT for quick alignment before access is handed over. I’ll send calendar invite once I have your availability.

Cheers,
Marcus
